theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_subspace_ball_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → y ∈ Q → 0 < ρ → μHE[n] ((Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball y ρ) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
